name: 2026 new-period validation (rules frozen)
registered_before: sampling, news collection and any verdict for 2026 events
why: The 2025 validation sample was already used once. This is a fresh period the rules never saw.

events.definition: events.py --v31 (market model z <= -1.96, common stock, D-1 market cap >= 100 billion KRW, no administrative issues)
events.period_reason: D+60 trading days must fall before the latest price date (2026-11-06)

collection_note: External press articles are included, as in live operation. The 2023-2025 samples did not include them.

judgment.frozen: No rule, prompt or parameter is changed after seeing any 2026 result. The run is done once.

primary_test.comparison: mean CAR(1,60) of 비가치 minus 가치훼손
primary_test.test: date-clustered t and date-block permutation p (backtest.py), alpha 0.05 one-sided reported alongside two-sided

not_possible_yet: Post-drop fundamentals (4 quarters after) are not available for 2026 events.
stop_rules: If collection is incomplete for an event (collection_incomplete), it is reported as held, not dropped.
